_provenance: Synthesized locally with espeak-ng 1.53.0 (built from source, MPL-licensed), NOT natural human speech. This is a real, reproducible, offline-generated test corpus for exercising language ID / ASR / MT / TTS integration and catching gross regressions - it is not a substitute for human-speech accuracy validation, which is a documented gap deferred to Phase 30 (dedicated multi-environment performance testing) until real recordings or a licensed speech corpus are available. All 9 clips say the same sentence ('Where is the train station?') so language-identification confusion and translation consistency can be checked across languages using one controlled utterance.
